whatsapp.q: How do I send receipts via WhatsApp?
whatsapp.a: Settings → WhatsApp receipts shows the number to send your receipts to. Only receipts from numbers listed under 'Allowed senders' are processed. Add your own number there, and the number of everyone who sends receipts for your business.

statuses.q: What do the statuses of an expense mean?
statuses.a:
Processing: the receipt is being read.
To review: check the details and approve or reject the expense.
Approved: the expense counts, also in the Tax Vault.
Rejected: the expense doesn't count.

manualExpense.q: Can I enter an expense myself?
manualExpense.a: Yes, with 'Nieuwe uitgave' (new expense) on the Expenses page. Shops you use often can be added as buttons with a fixed category under Settings → Lists & quick selection.

estimates.q: How accurate are the amounts in the Tax Vault?
estimates.a: They are estimates based on your invoices, your approved expenses and that year's tax rules. It isn't tax advice: you file the real return with your accountant. The more complete your tax settings (Settings → Tax), the better the estimate.

noIncomeTax.q: Why don't I see an income tax estimate?
noIncomeTax.a: For now the estimate only works for an eenmanszaak (sole proprietorship). Do you have one and still see nothing? Check that your tax settings are complete under Settings → Tax.

accountant.q: How do I give my data to my accountant?
accountant.a: Choose 'Nieuwe export' (new export) in the Tax Vault. Pick the period and the files your accountant wants. You can download the export or have it emailed to your accountant directly.

reports.a: On the Reports page: profit & loss, a VAT summary, invoices & open items and expenses by category. Click a report, choose the period and PDF or Excel, and confirm. The file goes to your downloads.

verifyEmail.q: I didn't receive a confirmation email.
verifyEmail.a: Check your spam folder too. Until your email address is confirmed, a notice with a 'Send again' button is shown at the top of the app.

changeLogin.q: How do I change my email address or password?
changeLogin.a: Under Settings → Account & security. You confirm the change with your current password. After a new password you are logged out on your other devices.

logoutAll.q: I lost my phone or logged in on a shared computer.
logoutAll.a: Use 'Sign out everywhere' under Settings → Account & security. This logs you out on all devices. To be safe, change your password too.

loggedOut.q: Why do I have to log in again?
loggedOut.a: Your session expired, or you were logged out through 'Sign out everywhere' or after a password change. Log in again; your data is kept.

languageTheme.q: How do I change the language or theme?
languageTheme.a: Under Settings → Language & display. Choose Dutch or English and a light, dark or system theme. This only applies to you.
